name: Disney's Grand Floridian Resort & Spa
description: The most prestigious and opulent hotel at Walt Disney World — Disney's Grand Floridian Resort & Spa is a magnificent Victorian-era resort hotel on the shores of the Seven Seas Lagoon with monorail direct access to Magic Kingdom, multiple award-winning restaurants, a stunning pool complex and the finest service at any Disney resort. The crown jewel of Walt Disney World hotels and one of the most beautiful resort hotels in America.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Elegant Victorian room with garden or pool views, free WiFi and marble bathroom.

rooms.name: Lagoon View Room
rooms.description: Premium room with Seven Seas Lagoon and Magic Kingdom views.

rooms.name: Junior Suite
rooms.description: Magnificent suite with lagoon views and complimentary breakfast.

name: Disney's Polynesian Village Resort
description: One of the most beloved and iconic hotels at Walt Disney World — Disney's Polynesian Village Resort is a spectacular South Pacific-themed resort on the Magic Kingdom monorail with stunning views of Cinderella Castle across the lagoon, extraordinary theming, multiple restaurants including the legendary Spirit of Aloha dinner show and the best hotel bar at Walt Disney World — Trader Sam's Grog Grotto.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Beautiful Polynesian-themed room with garden or pool views and free WiFi.

rooms.name: Lagoon View Room
rooms.description: Premium room with Seven Seas Lagoon and Cinderella Castle views.

rooms.name: Overwater Bungalow
rooms.description: Spectacular overwater bungalow with panoramic lagoon views and breakfast.

name: Disney's Contemporary Resort
description: The most architecturally distinctive hotel at Walt Disney World — Disney's Contemporary Resort is a stunning A-frame tower through which the Magic Kingdom monorail passes directly, offering extraordinary castle views, excellent dining and the closest hotel to Magic Kingdom. A Walt Disney World original opened in 1971.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Modern room with garden or pool views and free WiFi.

rooms.name: Magic Kingdom View Room
rooms.description: Tower room with direct Cinderella Castle and Seven Seas Lagoon views.

rooms.name: Junior Suite
rooms.description: Spacious suite with Magic Kingdom views and complimentary breakfast.

name: Disney's Wilderness Lodge
description: One of the most breathtaking and architecturally spectacular hotels at Walt Disney World — Disney's Wilderness Lodge is a magnificent Pacific Northwest-themed resort inspired by the grand National Park lodges of America featuring an extraordinary lobby with an eight-story stone fireplace, a geyser that erupts on schedule and the beautiful pools and forest setting of Bay Lake.

rooms.name: Standard Room
